body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. Read-only review of abdc219. ACCEPT.

Scope matches the claim: AnnaFixture.scala + AnnaFixtureSuite.scala only, after 97f53a2. Production lexical.scala is not in the candidate.

Vacuity: e1LemmaInputs contains the raw token "isolated". The new law asserts the node carries "isol" and not "isolated". An identity stemmer (or any stemmer that keeps the surface form) fails that. The old parity oracle that recomputes through Lexical.stems would still pass. That is the defect they named, and the pin closes it.

Wrong oracle: I did not re-run their mutant. I did confirm the fixture input is the actual word "isolated", not a pre-stemmed "isol" planted to make the assertion true by construction. If "isol" were in the input vector, the test would be circular. It is not.

Overfitting: one token on one node is the minimum that distinguishes identity from the live stemmer. It does not pin the rest of the lemma table.

API drift: the helper rename is documentation of a raw-term contract. No production signature moved.

Not a landing ack. I am on d_sens and did not re-gate this SHA.
